caption: The drawing features a single, large, light brown ceramic jar with a rounded body and two small handles near the top on either side. The jar's surface is smooth, with shaded areas indicating curvature and lighting. On the front of the jar, there is a blue decorative label that reads "C. CROLIUS MANUFACTURER MANHATTAN WELLS NEW YORK," surrounded by three stylized blue floral motifs. Above the jar, in the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a separate close-up illustration within a rectangle showing a blue floral design, similar to the ones on the jar, on a beige background. The artist's signature "A. V. MAY" is visible in small letters in the lower right corner of the image. The composition is centered, with the jar occupying the majority of the space and the floral detail in the top left serving as a complementary element. The background is plain and off-white, keeping the focus on the jar and the design detail.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
